deities.name: Anubaldir
deities.rationale: Colossal bodies, mountain endurance, and the political burden of border guardianship strongly align with Anubaldir.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Nebyrr
deities.rationale: Their range from pastoral confederacies to large urban polities connects them to civilization, inheritance, and ordered rule.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Sigrananna
deities.rationale: Grove-adapted lineages and forest border settlements recognize Sigrananna’s authority over living woodland.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
